body:
When the app opens, Solace checks what it needs on this machine and shows a short checklist in plain words. It never sends the user to a terminal without saying exactly what to do.

### Checks

- Gleam and Erlang (installed, and versions recent enough)
- An agent program, installed and signed in (reuse `board/agents.rs` detection)
- Sandboxing (`bubblewrap` on Linux), where lockdown needs it
- Git

### Behaviour

- Each missing item gets one sentence on why it is needed and the install step for this system (macOS, Debian/Ubuntu, Arch; detect which).
- A **Check again** button.
- Once everything passes, the checklist goes away and appears again only when something breaks.
- The tool list is the same as the README's Install section. Keep the two in step.
title: setup: first-run check in the app
